//==
// # Scene index types
//
// The zero-based typed indices that address into a Scene3D and its resource
// pools. A typed index can never be silently confused with another kind, and
// they all share one absence encoding.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (Value is zero-based, and -1
// means "none" / "not present").

// A zero-based index of a node within Scene3D.Nodes. -1 means "none"
// (a root's parent).
type SceneNodeIndex3D
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a mesh within SceneResources.Meshes. -1 means "none".
type MeshIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a material within SceneResources.Materials.
// -1 means "none" / "use the mesh's default".
type MaterialIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a light binding within SceneResources.LightBindings.
// -1 means "none".
type LightBindingIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a camera binding within
// SceneResources.CameraBindings. -1 means "none".
type CameraBindingIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

//==
// # Scene instancing and levels of detail
//
// Placed copies of the meshes in a SceneResources pool: single instances, the
// hardware-instanced form that shares one mesh across many transforms, and
// discrete level-of-detail groups. Mesh and Material fields are indices into
// SceneResources; distances are unit-agnostic scene Numbers.

// One placed copy of a mesh: Mesh and Material index into SceneResources;
// Transform is in world space.
type MeshInstance
    implements IValue
{
    Mesh: MeshIndex;
    Material: MaterialIndex;
    Transform: TrsTransform3D;
}

// Many placed copies of one mesh (hardware instancing). Mesh and Material
// index into SceneResources. Colors, when non-empty, runs parallel to
// Transforms and tints each instance; an empty Colors array means no
// per-instance color. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geometry_instancing)
type InstanceSet
    implements IValue
{
    Mesh: MeshIndex;
    Material: MaterialIndex;
    Transforms: Array<TrsTransform3D>;
    Colors: Array<Color>;
}

// Discrete levels of detail for one object. Meshes (indices into
// SceneResources.Meshes) and SwitchDistances are parallel arrays ordered by
// ascending distance: Meshes[i] is shown while the view distance from Center
// is below SwitchDistances[i]; beyond the last distance the object is culled.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_of_detail_(computer_graphics).
type LodGroup
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Meshes: Array<MeshIndex>;
    SwitchDistances: Array<Number>;
}
